⚠️ **This is an unofficial port.** All credit for the original mod goes to **[Azenski](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-dweller-king-recreation)** and **Flamc04**. This port was created solely to make the mod available on Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge. Please support the original authors!

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## The *New* Hydra has arrived on 1.20.1

The Hydra, also known as *"The Dweller King"*, is a terrifying cave dweller originally created by **Flamc04** and recreated by **Azenski**.

This is a faithful **1.20.1 Forge port** of [The Hydra: Reborn](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-dweller-king-recreation) (1.19.2), bringing the full experience to modern Minecraft.

### Stalk. Stare. Chase. Flee.

The Hydra is not just another mob — it *watches* you.

- **Stare Mode** — If you look at it, it freezes. Look away and it moves.
- **Chase Mode** — Once it picks its target, it hunts relentlessly through caves and corridors.
- **Flee Mode** — Under certain conditions it retreats... but not for long.
- **Stroll Mode** — Wanders the depths, waiting for its next victim.

If you hear distorted cave noises echoing around you... **it's already nearby.**

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

### Features

- High quality GeckoLib model, textures and animations
- Real and remade sounds (chase, cave ambience, flee, spotted, disappear)
- Advanced dweller AI with multiple behaviour states
- Climbs walls and breaks down doors
- Detects when players are looking at it
- Disables shields on attack
- Fully configurable via server-side config (spawn timers, attributes, behaviour toggles)
- Spawns deep underground and optionally on the surface
- Biome whitelist/blacklist support via datapack or config

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

### Requirements

- **Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge)**
- **[GeckoLib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib)** for 1.20.1

### Original Mod

➡️ [The Hydra: Reborn by Azenski](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-dweller-king-recreation) — support the original creator!

### Port

Ported to 1.20.1. No changes to gameplay, models, sounds or textures — this is a straight technical port.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
